about: Skylanders toys of the six games: toy type (block 1, 0x10), variant id (block 1, 0x1C), name, element, category, first game. The Spyro's Adventure and Giants toys and variants follow the games themselves (the SSA title's code, the Giants disc's toy tables: tools/toy_tables.py); the later games' from public toy lists. Sources and completeness: docs/runtime/host/collection.md. Override: catalogue.json in the collection folder (same format; its toys replace or add to these by type).
